every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget.description: every measurement of the offline first-save abort ran on a PATH with no wget, which the machine has — the bug is unmeasured on a faithful PATH
every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget.read_when: measuring an offline behaviour, or trusting the mason abort numbers

llm-launches-any-agent.description: `llm -a <program>` starts any agent on the proxy — the program is never registered, only its default args and env are
llm-launches-any-agent.read_when: launching an agent through the proxy, or adding one to agents.json

mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap.description: mason's registry refresh is off — launching Neovim offline discarded the first save; the fresh-machine bootstrap moves to install.sh
mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap.read_when: touching nvim's lsp.lua, mason, or the fresh-machine install path
